description:
About the Position

Chalmers University of Technology invites applications for a Doctoral Student position in Machine Learning for Quantum Error Correction within the Department of Electrical Engineering. The position is part of the QuBriC European Doctoral Network, funded by the Marie Skłodowska-Curie Actions programme.

Quantum error correction (QEC) is essential for building reliable quantum computers. In this PhD project, you will investigate how machine learning can enable faster, more scalable QEC decoding for surface codes and quantum LDPC codes.

Research Position Overview

The project aims to develop new learning-based decoders that meet the latency and hardware constraints required in practical quantum systems. You will work at the intersection of machine learning, quantum information science, and electrical engineering.

Research Areas

  • Machine learning for quantum error correction
  • Decoding algorithms for surface codes and quantum LDPC codes
  • Quantum computing hardware constraints
  • Scalable learning-based decoding
  • Latency-aware quantum error correction
